ROW.COLUMN: (IML/CU) Manipulation of Account/Customer Data followed by Instruction Changes

Instructions specify the details about how trades will be cleared and settled, and consequently direct flows of funds and securities into and out of accounts. This scenario identifies situations in which changes to instructions are preceded by modification to key account or customer information, such as names, addresses, or trading authorizations. These situations may involve a change in the ownership or control of an account.

All behavior-detection and alert-generation logic of this scenario is realized in one place - in the Primary Rule. Primary Rule Dataset (IML_Data_Manip_Prim_Rule) is build on the base of auxiliary Dataset IML_Data_Manip_Instr, which produce all instruction records( standing and ad hoc ) that experiened changes during Look Back Period and may be pertinent to the alert.
Primary Rule Dataset (IML_Data_Manip_Prim_Rule) looks asymmetric, considering only accounts changes because the customer info changes are propagate to all accounts associated to the customer, so there is no need to check both customer info and account info changes in the dataset.
All alert-generation conditions checks realized in dataset, so no father checkpoints needed in this pattern.
All other Sub-Rules and accordant Datasets doesn't take part in behavior-detection logic and just provide data for augmentation Instructions and highlignts.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @MINER@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @MINER@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)
SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.ACCT a inner join @MINER@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

-------------------------- -- IML_Data_Manip_Instr -- -------------------------- -- (114007709) -- Produce ALL instruction records( standing and ad hoc ) -- that experiened changes during Look Back Period -- and MAY be pertinent to the alert -- -- It realize ALL filters and restrictions -- for Instruction-Account-Customer chain -- -- Used in Aux. Sub-Rule for "Instructions" Supporting Dada -- -- It also serves as BASE dataset for other datasets in scenario -- select i.INSTR_SEQ_ID as INSTR_SEQ_ID, -- Dataset Key ID i.ACCT_INTRL_ID as ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.ACCT_SEQ_ID as ACCT_SEQ_ID, c.CUST_INTRL_ID as CUST_INTRL_ID, -- Focal Entity c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, -- for Effective risk level scoring binding -- We use instruction.data_dump_dt as date when instruction was set in force -- It was decided during call-session i.DATA_DUMP_DT as DATA_DUMP_DT from @MINER@.INSTRUCTION i inner join @MINER@.ACCT a on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = i.ACCT_INTRL_ID) inner join @MINER@.CUST c on (c.CUST_INTRL_ID = a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID) inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal on ( cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and -- We use data_dump_dt as date when instruction was set in force -- It was decided during call-session i.DATA_DUMP_DT > add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Frequency_Period) and i.DATA_DUMP_DT <= cal.CLNDR_DT ) where ( -- Standing instruction i.INSTR_TYPE_CD = 'S' and exists ( -- standing instruction record to be a change only if it replaces another -- standing instruction in the same account with the same product type select i1.INSTR_SEQ_ID from @MINER@.INSTRUCTION i1 where i1.ACCT_INTRL_ID = i.ACCT_INTRL_ID and i1.INSTR_TYPE_CD = 'S' -- Standing instruction and -- For the "same product type" mean for the records with the same fields -- INSTRUCTION.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD -- INSTRUCTION.PRDCT_TYPE_CD -- INSTRUCTION.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD nvl(i1.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, 'no_data') and nvl(i1.PRDCT_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i.PRDCT_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') and nvl(i1.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') and -- We use data_dump_dt as date when instruction was set in force -- It was decided during call-session -- -- ===== State: Implement by: wug at 4/20/2004 6:28:21 PM ===== -- there is one more condition needs to be considered too. -- When two standing instructions have the same data dump date, -- it's necessary to compare the INSTR_SEQ_IDs of these two instructions. ( i1.DATA_DUMP_DT < i.DATA_DUMP_DT or ( i1.DATA_DUMP_DT = i.DATA_DUMP_DT and i1.INSTR_SEQ_ID < i.INSTR_SEQ_ID ) ) ) --Rewritten to inner join --and --a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = i.ACCT_INTRL_ID --and --c.CUST_INTRL_ID = a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID -- -- Filter : Included Acct Type Codes and ( @All_Acct_Type_Fl = 'Y' or a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst) ) and ( @All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or c.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst) ) and -- Filter: " Exclude Exempt Customers c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Filter : Include Institutional customer accounts only and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' -- Rewritten to inner join -- Filter : Frequency Period --and --cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 --and --cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' --and -- We use data_dump_dt as date when instruction was set in force -- It was decided during call-session --i.DATA_DUMP_DT > add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Frequency_Period) --and --i.DATA_DUMP_DT <= cal.CLNDR_DT ) -- Standing instruction End or ( -- Ad-Hoc instruction i.INSTR_TYPE_CD = 'T' )

Scoring Binding acls.CHG_DT from @MINER@.ACCT_CHG_LOG_SMRY acls, @MINER@.ACCT a1, @MINER@.CUST c1 where c1.CUST_INTRL_ID = a1.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID and acls.ACCT_INTRL_ID = a1.ACCT_INTRL_ID -- Filter : Included Acct Type Codes and (@All_Acct_Type_Fl = 'Y' or a1.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst)) and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or c1.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- Filter: " Exclude Exempt Customers and c1.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Filter : Include Institutional customer accounts only and a1.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and acls.CHG_DT in (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period-1) union all --- CUST_CHG_LOG_SMRY has no column for ACCT_INTRL_ID. --- ALL Instructions are account based, so we base on undertanding that any change in Customer data --- will have impact to all Accounts where this Customer is Primary Customer select a2.ACCT_SEQ_ID as ACCT_SEQ_ID, c2.CUST_INTRL_ID as CUST_INTRL_ID, a2.ACCT_INTRL_ID as ACCT_INTRL_ID, c2.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, -- We need it for "Effective risk level" Scoring Binding ccls.CHG_DT from @MINER@.CUST_CHG_LOG_SMRY ccls, @MINER@.ACCT a2, @MINER@.CUST c2 where c2.CUST_INTRL_ID = a2.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID and ccls.CUST_INTRL_ID = c2.CUST_INTRL_ID -- Filter : Included Acct Type Codes and (@All_Acct_Type_Fl = 'Y' or a2.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst)) and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or c2.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- Filter: " Exclude Exempt Customers and c2.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Filter : Include Institutional customer accounts only and a2.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CI' and ccls.CHG_DT in (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE between 0 and @Look_Back_Period-1) ) cls )
select v.ACCT_SEQ_ID as ACCT_SEQ_ID, v.CUST_INTRL_ID as CUST_INTRL_ID, v.ACCT_INTRL_ID as ACCT_INTRL_ID, v.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB -- We need it for "Effective risk level" Scoring Binding from Log_Smry cls inner join -- View for dataset IML_Data_Manip_Instr @MINER@.dsview114007709 v on (v.ACCT_INTRL_ID = cls.ACCT_INTRL_ID) where -- We don't consider condition for cls.CUST_INTRL_ID -- because cls.CUST_INTRL_ID will be null for Account changes -- -- Condition : changes to instructions are preceded by modification -- to key account or customer information v.DATA_DUMP_DT >= cls.CHG_DT

------------------------------------------------ -- Dataset IML_Data_Manip_Instr_Prev -- ------------------------------------------------ -- (114012272) -- -- See KDS00024887 ( and KDS00024476 as a base idea) for details -- -- Dataset IML_Data_Manip_Instr produce all instruction records -- that are pertinent to the alert - experiesed change - but already AFTER -- change. -- -- This dataset (IML_Data_Manip_Instr_Prev) provide -- instruction as it was BEFORE change. -- -- Will be used with IML_Data_Manip_Instr-dataset for Match Augmentation to -- provide supporting data about instruction BEFORE change -- select max(i2.INSTR_SEQ_ID) as INSTR_SEQ_ID, -- PREVIOUS Instruction... i1.INSTR_SEQ_ID as THIS_STATE_INSTR_SEQ_ID -- ...for THIS Inctruction from @MINER@.INSTRUCTION i1, @MINER@.INSTRUCTION i2 where i1.ACCT_INTRL_ID = i2.ACCT_INTRL_ID and i1.INSTR_TYPE_CD = 'S' -- Standing instruction and -- For the "same product type" mean for the records with the same fields -- INSTRUCTION.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD -- INSTRUCTION.PRDCT_TYPE_CD -- INSTRUCTION.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD nvl(i1.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i2.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, 'no_data') and nvl(i1.PRDCT_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i2.PRDCT_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') and nvl(i1.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i2.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') and i1.INSTR_SEQ_ID > i2.INSTR_SEQ_ID group by i1.INSTR_SEQ_ID
